program.name: Sprint & Lift
program.subject: Athlete
program.blurb: Sprint starts or jumps, then strength in supersets, then balance.
program.about: Speed first, strength second. One day opens with sprint starts and short accelerations, then squat and hinge supersets; the other opens with jumps, then press and pull supersets. A balance circuit closes both. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III adds reps.
program.split: Sprint starts & lower supersets / jumps & upper supersets
